B.subject: Invoice BM-5512 on hold - delivery receipt needed (Trip TB-48377)
B.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice BM-5512 for $1,420.00 for trip TB-48377. We are placing it on hold for now because we cannot confirm delivery and no delivery receipt is attached to the invoice.

To move forward, please send a signed delivery receipt (proof of delivery) for trip TB-48377. Once we have it, we can continue reviewing the invoice.

If you have any questions, please reply to this message. Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable

C.subject: Invoice HS-1187 – Trip TB-48402 – Payment Adjustment
C.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice HS-1187 for trip TB-48402, totaling $2,395.00. We are processing $2,220.00 for payment.

The difference is the "Redelivery (second attempt)" charge of $175.00. This is not an approved extra on this trip, so we are unable to include it.

If you have written approval for this charge, please send it to us and we will gladly review it.

Thank you for your understanding and your work on this trip.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable

D.subject: Invoice CRC-3390 (Trip TB-48455) needs your decision
D.body:
Hi,

I'm escalating invoice CRC-3390 from Cascade Regional Carriers for trip TB-48455, with an invoice total of $2,400.00.

What conflicts: the base price on the invoice is $2,400.00, while the agreed price on record for this trip is $2,150.00. The carrier attached a document supporting its figure, so the two sources disagree and a manager needs to decide.

No payment is proposed until you decide. Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

Thank you.

H.subject: Invoice SPL-8842 – Trip TB-48560 – Payment Adjustment
H.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice SPL-8842 for trip TB-48560 from Summit Peak Logistics, totaling $1,975.00.

We are processing payment of $1,675.00 rather than the full amount. The "Layover (1 night)" charge of $300.00 is not an approved extra on this trip, so it is not included in the payment.

If you have written approval for this layover charge, please send it to us and we will review it.

Thank you for your understanding and for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable
